## Welcome!

Data is more than just numbers. When analysed and communicated effectively, it can reveal patterns, explain complex issues and support informed decision-making.

Through this website, I share my work in data analysis and visualisation, applying techniques developed throughout ETC5523: Communicating with Data at Monash University.

My aim is to make statistical findings accessible, engaging and meaningful to a wider audience.
